manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the small aluminum can and the cylindrical can with bright colors and place them in the portable light blue storage plasticbox

Task description: Put both the red small aluminum can to the left of the light blue storage box and the bright red-and-green cylindrical can on the right into the portable plastic storage box in the center.

Success criteria: Both jars are placed in the light blue storage box, each close horizontally to either of the box's two target placement locations; both grippers are open and have released the jars.

## Execution tips

- Grip opposite flat sides of the can body around its upper-middle section with both fingers, avoiding the rolled rim of the top. Set the opening slightly wider than the can diameter; before closing, confirm that the fingers surround the body to avoid knocking it over with an off-center grip.
- During transport, keep the can upright and its base above the box rim before moving it laterally into the box, avoiding a collision that could push the box.
- When lowering an item into the box, leave clearance between the fingers, box wall, and other can, and account for the sideways space needed to release. Avoid trapping the fingers or knocking over a can already inside.
- Before release, let the can base rest on the box bottom. Open until the fingers clear the body, then withdraw through an open gap, avoiding a tip-over from releasing while suspended or moving it during withdrawal.
